Thanks for taking the time on Friday to walk through the high-level on-prem deployment goals. As discussed, we put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to align owners and the close timeline for a Private/VPC deployment with VPN peering and KMS integration. Attached: heliobank-map-draft.xlsx (MAP with milestones).

Quick summary and owners we propose (please confirm or correct):
- Networking/VPN owner (customer): Jordan Smith / HelioBank Infra Team
- Redwood networking lead: Marcus Lin (routing, peering config, IP plan)
- KMS / key policy owner (customer): Aisha Rahman (will own KMS provisioning and HSM requests)

- Redwood solutions & validation: Priyom Das (evaluation plan, test harness)

Near-term asks:
1) Please confirm the HelioBank networking contact (name + email) and your preferred IP ranges to reserve for peering.
2) Confirm whether HelioBank will provide a customer-managed KMS key (BYOK) or we should use a Redwood-managed envelope key. If BYOK, please share the KMS key ARN and desired IAM principals.
3) Request a 60-min kickoff this week to go over the MAP and put concrete dates on the milestones (POC network test, KMS proof-of-concept, production cutover).

Target commercial close (per our pre-call): 2026-12-18 — we'll use that as the baseline unless you want to accelerate.

Attachments: heliobank-map-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Team — adding a few technical notes to help the kickoff so we don't get stuck on the first call:

VPN / networking checklist:
- Peering options: IPsec VPN tunnel (preferred for on-prem -> Redwood VPC) vs. transit VPC if they want BGP. For POC, static routes over IPsec are fine.
- IP ranges: reserve the two /24s Jordan suggested and confirm NAT requirements for control-plane access.
- Firewall: we need outbound ports TCP 443, 22 (for admin jump host), and a narrow set of ephemeral ports for agent heartbeats.
- Test plan: we should validate latency and per-second connection trends under a small synthetic load (Priyom to own).

KMS / IAM notes:
- If HelioBank provides a BYOK in their cloud KMS, we need a service account principal we can call for envelope encryption; please include the ARN and the principal emails.
- For HSM-backed keys, document the FIPS level/HSM vendor — if procurement timeline is long we can use a temporary KMS key for evaluation and then rotate to BYOK before cutover.
- Monica: please prepare the minimal IAM policy template to request from the customer (read/encrypt for Redwood service principal, list-keys restricted).

Attachments I'm dropping into the shared Drive ahead of the call: network-topology-v1.pdf, kms-access-roster.csv (initial roster for principals).

Agenda suggestion for kickoff (60 min):
1) Introductions & owner confirmations (10m)
2) Network topology and peering method (15m)
3) KMS/BYOK approach & IAM policy (15m)
4) Test plan, timelines, and next milestones (15m)

I'll take responsibility for the runbook sections related to topology and cutover steps.

-vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
